---
title: "Pixi"
subtitle: "One file lists the software a project needs; a lock file pins every version, for every platform"
---

## Start and add software

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| A new workspace with the bioinformatics channels | `pixi init NAME -c conda-forge -c bioconda` |
| Add packages (updates `pixi.toml` and `pixi.lock`) | `pixi add samtools bcftools` |
| Add with a version limit | `pixi add "samtools>=1.24"` |
| Add to a feature (tools for some platforms only) | `pixi add --feature pipeline bwa samtools` |
| Remove a package | `pixi remove bwa` |
| Start from a Conda `environment.yml` | `pixi init --import environment.yml NAME` |

See [lesson 05, section 2](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#a-practice-workspace-manifest-and-lock-file).

## Run

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Run a command in the project's environment | `pixi run samtools --version` |
| Run it in another environment | `pixi run -e pipeline samtools --version` |
| Open a shell in the environment (leave with `exit`) | `pixi shell` |
| Run a tool once, without adding it to the project | `pixi exec --spec cookiecutter -- cookiecutter ...` |
| ... from Bioconda, in an exact version | `pixi exec -c conda-forge -c bioconda --spec "fastqc==0.12.1" -- fastqc --help` |

See [section 3](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#pixi-run-and-pixi-shell).

## See what you have

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Installed packages | `pixi list` (another environment: `pixi list -e pipeline`) |
| Why a package is there | `pixi tree samtools` |
| Exact versions, for the README | `pixi list -e pipeline --explicit > docs/software-versions.txt` |

## The lock file

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Write or update `pixi.lock` without installing | `pixi lock` |
| Rebuild exactly what the lock file says | `pixi install --locked` |
| Delete the installed environments (`.pixi/envs/`) | `pixi clean` |
| Newer versions within the limits in `pixi.toml` | `pixi update` |
| Raise the limits to the newest versions | `pixi upgrade` |

See [section 4](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#prove-it-rebuild-from-the-lock-file). Commit `pixi.toml` and `pixi.lock` together.

## Platforms, features and environments

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Give a feature its own platforms | `pixi workspace platform add --feature pipeline linux-64 osx-arm64 osx-64` |
| Make an environment from a feature | `pixi workspace environment add pipeline --feature pipeline` |

See [section 7](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#features-and-environments).

## Tasks

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| List the tasks | `pixi task list` |
| Add a task | `pixi task add download "python scripts/download_data.py" --description "TEXT"` |
| Add a task to a feature, after another task | `pixi task add --feature pipeline qc "COMMAND" --depends-on download` |
| One task that runs others | `pixi task alias reproduce qc variant-calling report` |
| Remove a task | `pixi task remove reproduce` (a feature's task: `--feature pipeline`) |
| Run a task | `pixi run reproduce` |

See [section 8](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#tasks-for-the-pipeline).

## Your own tools, everywhere

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Install a tool for yourself, outside any project | `pixi global install cookiecutter` |
| List them | `pixi global list` |

See [section 9](../pages/05-pixi.qmd#personal-tools-with-pixi-global).

## For Conda users

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| An `environment.yml` from an environment | `pixi workspace export conda-environment -e pipeline envs/pipeline.yml` |
| Exact Conda specs, one file per platform | `pixi workspace export conda-explicit-spec -e pipeline envs/explicit` |

The full Conda-to-Pixi command table is in [lesson 05b](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd#the-command-table);
Conda's own commands are on the [Conda and Mamba](conda.qmd) cheat sheet.

## `pixi.toml` at a glance

```{.toml}
[workspace]
channels = ["conda-forge", "bioconda"]
platforms = ["linux-64", "osx-arm64", "osx-64", "win-64"]

[dependencies]                 # the default environment
python = "3.13.*"
quarto = ">=1.9"

[tasks]
download = { cmd = "python scripts/download_data.py", description = "Download and verify the raw data" }
reproduce = [{ task = "report" }]

[feature.pipeline]             # tools that do not run on Windows
platforms = ["linux-64", "osx-arm64", "osx-64"]

[feature.pipeline.dependencies]
samtools = ">=1.24,<2"

[feature.pipeline.tasks]
qc = { cmd = "fastqc ...", depends-on = ["download"] }

[environments]
pipeline = ["pipeline"]
```

## Official cheat sheets and references

Pixi has no official cheat sheet. Its command reference lists every command
and option, and Pixi installs the same packages as Conda, so the Conda cheat
sheet maps over:

- **Pixi command reference**: <https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/reference/cli/pixi/>
- Pixi, *Switching from Conda*: <https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/switching_from/conda/>
- Pixi, *Advanced tasks*: <https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/workspace/advanced_tasks/>
- Pixi, *Multiple environments*: <https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/workspace/multi_environment/>
- **Conda cheat sheet**, from the Conda project: <https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda/en/latest/user-guide/cheatsheet.html>
